design.title: ACE-style dense per-patch scene-coordinate head: 64 supervised map-coordinate predictions per crop replace the single GAP-pooled guess
design.eli5: Until now the model looked at a photo, squashed everything it saw into one overall impression -- like describing a neighborhood by its average color -- and made a single guess at where the photo was taken. Ambiguous impressions get dragged toward the middle of the map, which is exactly the ~1.9 km error we keep seeing. Now every small patch of the photo makes its own guess about where on the map that exact patch of ground sits, and the patches vote, with the model learning which patches to trust. Each practice photo used to teach one lesson; now it teaches 64 smaller, easier lessons -- placing a distinctive rooftop is much easier than placing a blurry average of everything.
design.hypothesis: The binding constraint is the descriptor/supervision bottleneck exp 3 pre-registered as its own prime suspect: after full-lattice streaming was kept, the score barely moved (1993.71 -> 1872.75 m, still map-centroid scale), which exp 3's refutation signature says exonerates data coverage and indicts 'trunk capacity / descriptor pooling'. TinyLocNet global-average-pools its 8x8x128 feature map into one 128-d bag-of-textures and makes exactly ONE supervised prediction per crop -- a rotation-blind texture summary regressed against a multimodal answer space, which is precisely the regression-to-the-mean geometry. The nadir-aerial setting offers a fix the scene-coordinate literature (ACE/DSAC, cited as prior art in CLAUDE.md section 3) is built on: every 16x16-px patch of a crop has a closed-form ground-truth map coordinate derivable from (cx, cy, angle), because the ground is flat and the crop is metric (1 px = 1 gsd). Replacing the GAP+Linear head with a 1x1-conv dense head that predicts a map coordinate PER 8x8 spatial cell, aggregated by a learned softmax vote, converts each presentation into 64 spatially distinct supervised examples (64x denser gradient signal at the same step count), makes the supervision rotation-equivariant instead of demanding rotation invariance from a pooled descriptor, and replaces one global multimodal regression with 64 local, better-conditioned ones. Trunk, data diet, step count, and optimizer stay identical, isolating the head+supervision as the single variable. This is exp 2's 'reparameterize the output' instinct taken in the direction the prior art actually validates (dense local prediction), not a retry of its refuted global cell-softmax under-the-same-single-target regime.
